title: eFoil Lessons on Cape Cod
requirements: Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Entering the 5th year of operation, we are the Cape’s top destination for eFoiling. Whether you are a total beginner or an experienced boarder, we provide a safe, exhilarating path to flying. Why Fly With Us?

Certified Expertise: We are the only registered Lift and Fliteboard affiliate on mainland Cape Cod. You are learning on the world’s best equipment from instructors who know the tech inside and out.

Value: We pride ourselves on offering the most competitive rates in our area. Get an excellent experience for much less than other affiliate schools.

Travel Lessons: Can’t make it to our Barnstable or Provincetown hubs? We offer Travel Lessons and Events, bringing the boards, the gear, and the expertise directly to your private beach or waterfront home.

Discounted Buying: As a professional partner for both Lift and Fliteboard, we offer the clients exclusive discounts on new and used eFoils.
